Project.title: SFT Project
Project.description: An SFT project containing configuration presets and dataset batches

batches.description: List of dataset batches belonging to the project

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the project was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the project was last updated

Batch.title: SFT Dataset Batch
Batch.description: An incremental batch of synthetic or converted SFT training examples

source.description: Generation source (Generator, Doc Conversion, TRiAD Alignment, Dataset Import)

templateType.description: Format template (Single Turn, Multi Turn, System Reasoner)

examplesCount.description: Number of examples in this batch

examples.description: List of SFT examples in this batch

description.description: Summary description of the batch generation

User.title: User Profile
User.description: Stores user subscription status, limit, and code redemptions

subscriptionStatus.description: The tier level of the user

limit.description: Maximum number of examples allowed (50, 1000, or 5000)

redeemedCode.description: The student code redeemed by the user, if any

StudentCode.title: Student Code
StudentCode.description: Redemption code for classes allowing 5000 examples up to 10 uses

redemptionCount.description: Number of times the code has been redeemed (max 10)

redeemedUserIds.description: List of user UIDs who have redeemed this code

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the code was created

projects/{projectId}/batches/{batchId}.description: Store individual incremental dataset batches under a project

users/{userId}.description: Store user profiles, subscriptions, and limits

student_codes/{codeId}.description: Store student class codes and redemption logs
